baseline_models.focus_anchor: صبروا حتى تخرج إليهم لكان خيرا لهم
baseline_models.mechanism: Voluntary restraint holds the callers' impulse until the addressee initiates the inside-to-outside crossing; the counterfactual then locates خير in that reordered sequence, not merely in elapsed time.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint from panic supplies an active check on the callers' impulse.
Passage from an interior to an exterior fixes the endpoint while leaving initiative with the one who exits.
Occurrence in time makes the better state depend on a particular order of events.
Choosing or seeking the better option makes waiting a deliberate alternative rather than inertia.

changed_reading.before: They should simply have waited until the addressee appeared.
changed_reading.after: They should have surrendered control of access, restraining their demand so the addressee controlled when private presence became public.

baseline_models.mechanism: The close does not cancel the rebuke: protective pardon shields the offender from the breach's terminal consequence, while tenderness keeps relation and correction possible.

activation_trace.role: Covering an offense while shielding its bearer from consequence supplies accountable pardon.
Tender mercy turns pardon toward renewed relation rather than mere concealment.

changed_reading.before: The divine names are a reassuring formula appended after an etiquette correction.
changed_reading.after: The ending makes failed restraint repairable: the boundary remains real, but its violators are not permanently expelled by the violation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صبروا حتى تخرج إليهم ... غفور رحيم
baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus roots converge on a container: patience can mark an edge or stopper, exit crosses its boundary, forgiveness covers protectively, and mercy can evoke a womb. The pause therefore preserves an interior until self-timed emergence.

activation_trace.role: The edge or side of a vessel gives patience a threshold-shaped spatial image.
A stopper or plug supplies temporary closure rather than permanent exclusion.
Movement out of a containing interior supplies the release event.
Protective covering makes enclosure preservative rather than punitive.
The womb supplies a generative interior whose value depends on protected timing.

changed_reading.before: Waiting is only a temporal pause outside a room.
changed_reading.after: Waiting preserves the integrity of a bounded interior until its occupant crosses the threshold; mercy names the protective, potentially generative quality of that restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition on advancing, the messenger's branch of deliberateness, and the chamber's enclosing boundary turn 49:5 into the concrete access form of non-preemption; reason itself is figured as the restraint that prevents ignorant intrusion.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the inward brake required by non-preemption.
The addressee's own crossing supplies the authorized transition to access.
Advancing and taking precedence identifies the sequence violation that patience would prevent.
Gentleness and deliberateness give messenger-centered order a measured pace.
Prevention and enclosure make the rooms a meaningful boundary, not incidental scenery.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance links cognitive discipline to respecting the enclosure.

structural_cues: 49:1 prohibits getting ahead; 49:2-3 regulate voice; 49:4 locates the call beyond an enclosure; 49:5 supplies the missed alternative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, measured messengership, enclosure, and restraining reason; I infer that waiting operationalizes their shared order; a live alternative is that 49:5 concerns only local residential courtesy.

changed_reading.before: The callers failed at private courtesy.
changed_reading.after: They enacted the surah's opening error in miniature: they promoted their demand ahead of the messenger's initiative and crossed an institutional as well as residential boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowering an outward signal is joined to an ordeal that discloses and refines the heart. The missed pause in 49:5 can therefore function as both evidence and formation of inward fitness, with خير naming excellence rather than convenience alone.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self from reactive impulse provides the behavioral assay.
Chosen excellence lets خير denote cultivated quality as well as benefit.
Checking and lowering an output supplies the observable form of inward regulation.
An ordeal that reveals what is in the heart turns restraint into a diagnostic event.
The heart locates the tested quality beneath the audible behavior.
Putting oneself under protection makes restraint a durable inward disposition.

structural_cues: 49:3 moves from lowered voices to hearts tested for taqwa immediately before the failed calling scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduced voice, heart-disclosing trial, and self-protection; I infer that the pause would reveal and refine the same inward capacity; a live alternative is that the promised good is an external reward only.

changed_reading.before: Patience would have earned a better outcome.
changed_reading.after: Patience would have manifested and trained a heart able to govern its own urgency in the messenger's presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pause becomes an epistemic buffer: what arrives or breaks into the open is not thereby reliable, so clarification must make meaning emerge before ignorance becomes an irreversible strike and then regret.

activation_trace.role: Impulse-restraint supplies time in which evidence can be tested.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the model of disclosed evidence.
A ripe fruit breaking out of its shell supplies a branch-distant warning that emergence alone does not certify what emerged.
An arriving, transmitted report supplies the uncertain input.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the verification process.
Agitated lack of forbearance supplies the affective route from uncertainty to premature action.
Regret over what has passed supplies the irreversible cost of skipping the buffer.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders arrival, report, verification, possible injury, deed, and regret as a causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incoming news, clarification, agitation, action, and regret; I infer that 49:5's waiting generalizes locally into evidence latency; a live alternative is that the two pauses regulate unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: Waiting protects the etiquette of physical access.
changed_reading.after: Waiting also protects action from prematurely externalized information, distinguishing trustworthy disclosure from mere arrival or rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated endpoint construction and the later branch that makes sin a delay from good prevent a flat equation of patience with slowness. Restraint is calibrated to the rightful transition: do not force access before emergence, but do not glorify delay after return or good is due.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the held interval, not an unlimited postponement.
Temporal occurrence ties value to when the transition happens.
Transgressing a limit supplies the condition under which mere waiting no longer answers the situation.
Return and turning back supply a distinct endpoint after which the response changes.
Slowness that falls behind good supplies the counterexample to treating every delay as virtuous.

structural_cues: The construction حتى تخرج in 49:5 is echoed by حتى تفيء in 49:9, but each endpoint governs a different response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bounded-until sequences plus delay that misses good; I infer a norm of calibrated timing; a live alternative is that the repeated grammar has no cross-scene force.

changed_reading.after: Patience means timing agency correctly: hold a demand before another's rightful emergence, yet do not mistake delay itself for good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reversal that the targeted group may be better destabilizes the demander's assumed rank. A branch of mockery also exposes instrumental subjugation, while wrong places and times recast impatient access as a small injustice of positioning.

activation_trace.role: Choosing the better alternative opens خير beyond immediate advantage.
Mockery supplies the overt social posture of ranking another beneath oneself.
Subduing and driving something toward one's purpose exposes the latent instrumental posture inside demanded availability.
Comparative excellence reverses the observers' confidence about who is better.
Putting something in the wrong time or physical place makes the breach both temporal and spatial.

structural_cues: 49:11 repeats خيرا in an explicit reversal between judging subject and judged target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mockery, instrumental subjection, reversed comparative worth, and misplacement; I infer that impatient calling presumes rank and availability; a live alternative is that خير in 49:5 remains simple benefit with no status critique.

changed_reading.before: Waiting is better because it produces a more favorable encounter.
changed_reading.after: Waiting is better because demanders must suspend their presumed rank and cannot convert another person's presence into an instrument of their urgency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks people to await an outward exit; later context denies covert extraction, distinguishes professed faith from faith entering the heart, and reserves comprehensive sight of the unseen to God. Public emergence and inward entry thus have different owners.

activation_trace.role: An interior-to-exterior crossing supplies voluntary public emergence.
Protective covering grants hiddenness a positive function rather than treating it as an obstacle.
The womb supplies an interior whose opacity and timing are conditions of formation.
Secretly tracking information supplies the prohibited alternative to waiting for disclosure.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain humans cannot make fully public on demand.
Assent that settles the heart distinguishes an inward arrival from a verbal claim.
Entry into an interior reverses the focus movement and reveals the asymmetry between bodily exit and inward faith.
Insight of the heart locates comprehensive discernment with God rather than the impatient observer.

structural_cues: 49:5 waits for تخرج; 49:14 denies that faith has yet يدخل the hearts; 49:18 closes with divine knowledge of the unseen and sight of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward exit, inward entry, anti-surveillance, unseen reality, and divine sight; I infer differentiated sovereignty over interiors; a live alternative is that the in/out reversal is verbal coincidence.

changed_reading.before: The verse protects a person's physical privacy until he comes outside.
changed_reading.after: The verse protects interiority as such: humans may await public disclosure, but they may neither force it nor claim mastery over what has entered another's heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direction of favor reverses in 49:17: people burden the messenger with an asserted favor, but God releases and guides them as gift. The خير of 49:5 is therefore not a return purchased by patient behavior; patience relinquishes the claim to purchase access at all.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift make the promised good receivable rather than collectible.
Merciful beneficence keeps the better outcome in the register of grace.
Burdening a beneficiary by recounting a favor exposes transactional leverage.
Release without compensation supplies the opposite direction of genuine favor.
A gentle dispatch or gift to one loved casts guidance as bestowed rather than owed.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats يمنون across the human claim and the divine reversal, changing who can place whom under obligation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor-as-burden, release without price, and guidance-as-gift; I infer that demanded access carries an entitlement ledger; a live alternative is that 49:17 corrects only boasting about conversion.

changed_reading.before: Waiting is a means by which the callers could obtain a better return.
changed_reading.after: Waiting abandons transactional leverage over the messenger's time, allowing خير to be received as gift rather than claimed as payment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Brotherhood, reconciliation, and the kinship branch of mercy give the focus ending a communal task: pardon after boundary failure should restore a relation capable of regulated access, not merely erase an individual's fault.

activation_trace.role: Shielding the offender from the offense's consequence opens a route back into relation.
The kinship bond lets mercy carry a social connective force.
Brotherhood and kinship identify the community that must survive its members' breaches.
Removing alienation between people supplies the repair mechanism.
Mercy as kinship binds divine pardon to restored communal relation.

structural_cues: 49:10 places brotherhood, reconciliation, protection, and mercy in one sequence; mercy recurs after further social and confessional breaches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship, reconciliation, and recurring mercy; I infer that 49:5's close aims at reintegration after access failure; a live alternative is that the close concerns only divine forgiveness of individuals.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness softens the rebuke for the rude callers.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness repairs the callers into a community whose bonds must remain intact while its boundaries become more disciplined.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a zoological branch of خير, not its ordinary comparative sense. It remains valid as a micro-image because the branch sits on focus-word خيرا, joins focus-word تخرج, and is sharpened by the chamber enclosure and instrumental subjection in context. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory anti-extraction analogy, never a lexical translation of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: Coaxing an animal from its burrow supplies the odd extraction scene latent in خير.
Self-directed passage from inside to outside supplies the alternative to coaxed extraction.
An enclosed place makes the burrow-like spatial analogy visibly attach to the preceding chambers.
Driving a being toward one's own purpose names the instrumental pressure that the waiting alternative refuses.

changed_reading.before: It would have been better to wait for the resident to come out.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the better act is precisely not to lure or drive an enclosed other into availability, but to let emergence remain the other's act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because four focus roots and two context roots align into a medical chain: bitter treatment, eruption, wound relapse, and post-birth pain. Every link is branch-backed and the model remains anchored to the focus rebuke and closing mercy. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for recurrent social injury, not as the verse's denotation or a diagnosis.

activation_trace.role: A bitter medicinal extract makes restraint the unpleasant treatment that prevents a worse course.
An erupting abscess supplies a damaged form of forced or pathological emergence.
Relapse of an illness or wound turns forgiveness into protection against recurrence.
Pain in the womb after birth keeps mercy close to vulnerable aftermath rather than painless softness.
A wound relapsing and leaving an effect reinforces the context's concern with damage that can return unnoticed.
A wound corrupting and exceeding its boundary supplies the social danger of an untreated breach spreading.

changed_reading.before: Pardon follows a discrete lapse of etiquette.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, restraint is bitter prophylaxis against forcing an eruption, while forgiveness and mercy treat the vulnerable aftermath and guard against social relapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads an atmospheric process across branch-distant senses of three focus roots. It remains anchored by their exact focus occurrences and is lightly activated by the surah's closing sky-earth horizon. Downstream prose should qualify it as a process analogy about maturation and release, not claim that patience, exit, or forgiveness literally means weather here.

activation_trace.role: Layered cloud supplies accumulation that looks static while a process is forming.
Cloud emergence and sky clearing supply the eventual release and disclosure.
Protective covering allows temporary opacity to serve rather than merely obstruct.
The sky as an overhead cover enlarges the focus's latent atmospheric field.
Soft productive earth supplies the receptive endpoint beneath the sky's delayed process.

changed_reading.before: Waiting tolerates a temporary obstruction until it disappears.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, latency is productive accumulation: the covering matures its own emergence and clearing, so forcing visibility early would interrupt the process that makes it good.

strongest_changes: The verse shifted from ordinary waiting to non-preemptive access in which the other party owns the transition from private to public presence.
The physical pause became an epistemic and interior discipline: disclosure must emerge, be clarified, and not be replaced by surveillance or claims about another heart.
خير shifted from a transactional payoff toward comparative humility and gift, undoing the demander's presumed rank and leverage.
Patience became calibrated timing rather than delay as such, with later context preserving both restraint before a threshold and action when a rightful endpoint arrives.
summary.what_was_special: The unusually dense inside-outside system supported several coexisting mechanisms without requiring a single synthesis: authority order, heart assay, evidence latency, interior sovereignty, communal repair, and contained material images of burrow extraction, wound relapse, protected gestation, and cloud maturation.
remaining_uncertainties: The container, medical, burrow, and cloud models are strongly cross-anchored but remain branch-distant analogies whose prose weight should stay lower than the access and interior readings.
It remains uncertain how far 49:6, 49:9, and 49:12 generalize the focus pause beyond the specific protocol of access to the messenger.
The calibrated-delay reading depends on treating repeated endpoint grammar and the delay-from-good branch as a deliberate contrast rather than reconstructed resonance.
